item.title: Identifying Packages Used by Flutter Apps
item.description: Sometimes it’s useful to determine what Flutter packages are used in a Flutter app. This can be useful for security audits, vulnerability assessments, or just to understand the app better. Technique# For android apps, extract or export the libapp.so file from the APK file. This file is usually located in the lib/<architecture>/ directory inside the APK file. For iOS, you can find an equivalent binary file in the Frameworks/App.framework/App inside the extracted IPA file.
